name: Memory Recall
description: L1/L2/L3 cascade memory recall: per-agent LanceDB (vector + FTS) + NetworkX graph expansion. Async LLM extraction (6w+confidence), Weibull decay, progressive compaction. No external server needed.

autoRecall.description: Automatically inject relevant memories before each reply

autoRecallMaxItems.description: Maximum memories to inject per turn

decayEnabled.description: Enable Weibull decay + compaction timer (runs every decayIntervalHours)

llmModel.description: Ollama model for LLM extraction (e.g. qwen2.5:3b, qwen3.5:4b)

textMinLength.description: Minimum text length to trigger auto-store (messages shorter than this are ignored)
